rules.description: Compare invoice and PO price information and invoice quantities with exactly joined selected receipt evidence.

provenance.note: The three-way comparison concept is documented; this file's exact export fields and validation policy are synthetic.

rules.description: Support explicitly selected partial receipt quantities and receipts available at the stated cutoff.

provenance.note: Partial receipt matching and availability through a current date are documented. The explicit as_of instant and fixed-offset calendar are sample implementations.

rules.description: ASCII-trim and uppercase only vendor numbers; hold every incoming duplicate entity/vendor/number key, including matches to posted history available by as_of.

provenance.note: The product documents configured posted-number checks, not this normalization, three-part key or all-incoming-duplicates policy.

rules.description: Reject malformed or unknown fields and repeated technical keys; require bounded true integers, HALF_UP line arithmetic and header sums; never coerce or silently ignore components.

provenance.note: Milliunits, cents, bounded exports, diagnostic precedence, zero-component scope and integer-only arithmetic are invented sample controls.

rules.description: Require both inclusive symmetric unit-price basis-point and per-line minor-unit-cap tests. A zero-price PO requires zero invoice price and net.

provenance.note: Default 200 bps and 500 cents are fictional, not the product's full cumulative price-total policy.

rules.description: Reject unapproved controls; hold pending/future PO approval and future invoices; exclude receipts/history/allocations not available at as_of explicitly.

provenance.note: Approved synthetic configuration grants classification only. Fixed integer offsets and time-aware historical integrity are explicit sample controls.

rules.description: Require explicit exact-sum selection or a sole sufficient positive-capacity receipt; validate historical receipt/PO capacity, then hold all eligible competitors for every globally oversubscribed resource.

provenance.note: No FIFO, subset guessing, first winner, clamping, partial invoice release or same-run retry.

rules.description: Remove every individually held invoice before global competition; retain all line evidence, propose only complete remaining invoices and preserve all quantities and amounts for human review.

provenance.note: All packets have human_review=pending and live_action=none. No posting, payment, permission or real allocation mutation.

steps.title: Read synthetic document exports
steps.procedure: Read the operator's immutable batch, explicit as_of, controls and six source-row counts. Do not infer live access.

steps.title: Validate document integrity
steps.procedure: Validate shapes, bounds, keys, timestamps, header/line arithmetic and authoritative receipt/PO/history references and historical capacities. Reject before financial classification on any integrity error.

steps.title: Join invoice keys and purchase orders
steps.procedure: Build all canonical current and eligible posted-history keys. Join exact entity/PO/PO-line keys and test vendor, currency, unit and approval without fuzzy matching.

steps.title: Resolve receipt evidence
steps.procedure: Subtract eligible history, expose cutoff exclusions, resolve explicit selections or a sole sufficient receipt, and retain available and requested quantities.

steps.title: Evaluate individual invoice conditions
steps.procedure: Calculate HALF_UP line nets, exact price cross-products and line deltas; record line holds and per-invoice aggregate receipt/PO shortages before competition.

steps.title: Resolve all capacity competitors together
steps.procedure: Remove all individually held invoices, aggregate all remaining receipt and PO demand simultaneously, and hold every participant on every oversubscribed resource. Do not retry freed capacity.

steps.title: Route atomic invoice holds
steps.procedure: Retain every original line evaluation, emit owned diagnostics and exclusions, and withhold all proposals for every held invoice.

steps.title: Emit review-only AP packet
steps.procedure: Emit all rows, proposed allocations, resource conflicts, remaining capacities, historical evidence, exclusions and per-scope ready/held totals with pending AP manager review and no live action.
